baseline_models.focus_anchor: The plural predicate مُغْرَمُونَ, rooted in غ ر م, presents the speakers as placed under a binding condition.
baseline_models.mechanism: A monetary loss or charge has become incumbent on the speakers, so the utterance functions as a negative ledger verdict rather than a generic cry of pain.

activation_trace.role: The branch's binding monetary charge supplies both the incurred loss and its continuing liability.

changed_reading.after: We have incurred a binding loss or charge that remains on our account.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: مُغْرَمُونَ can activate the relational غريم image, not only the amount owed.
baseline_models.mechanism: The speakers have entered a creditor-debtor bond in which one party remains attached to the other; the emphasis shifts from loss as quantity to loss as an inescapable relation.

activation_trace.role: The branch's mutual clinging of creditor and debtor makes the focus condition relational and hard to exit.

changed_reading.after: We are now held in a claimant-obligor relation that will not release us.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The غرام branch of مُغْرَمُونَ carries calamity whose defining feature is ملازمة, continued adherence.
baseline_models.mechanism: The speakers diagnose not a punctual setback but an affliction that stays, turning the nominal predicate into a durable state.

activation_trace.role: The branch's lasting torment, destruction, and hardship supplies a calamity whose force lies in persistence.

changed_reading.before: A disaster has happened to us.
changed_reading.after: We have been caught by a disaster that abides with us.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The same غ ر م inventory permits مُغْرَمُونَ to be heard through intense attachment and fixation.
baseline_models.mechanism: The state may describe people engrossed by an object or expectation, with their predicament located partly in an attachment they cannot disengage from.

activation_trace.role: The branch's infatuated clinging supplies an affective fixation as a possible focus-state.

changed_reading.after: We are consumed by, and unable to detach from, what has seized our desire.

context_deltas.mechanism: Creation, measured governance, inability to get beyond the governing power, and replaceability expand the creditor bond into derivative agency: those who do not originate or secure themselves are held under a prior claim.

activation_trace.role: The creditor-debtor attachment supplies the relational frame into which the agency asymmetry is read.
The branch's origination of created existence assigns the originating side of the asymmetric relation.
The branch's deliberate apportioning makes mortality part of an ordered account rather than an accidental loss.
The branch's escaping beyond a pursuer, here negated, gives the bond its inescapable reach.
The branch's replacement of one thing by another makes the speakers non-sovereign over their own continuance.

structural_cues: The sequence opposes first-person plural acts of creation and apportionment to second-person plural dependence.
Death, non-escape, and replacement precede the focus's liability predicate.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies origination, apportionment, non-escape, and replacement; I infer that this asymmetry can be rendered as a prior creditor-like claim. A live alternative is that the sequence asserts power without licensing debt language.

changed_reading.before: We are attached to a claimant because of a particular loss.
changed_reading.after: Our very derivative agency places us under a claim we cannot outrun or cancel.

context_deltas.mechanism: Human work and expected growth are converted into pulverized matter; the focus liability is therefore the unrecovered labor and expected yield left on the speakers' side of the account.

activation_trace.role: The branch's binding financial loss supplies the negative balance produced by failed yield.
The branch's work, earning, and accumulation supplies the human input entered into the harvest account.
The branch's causing seed to grow supplies the expected productive return while separating it from mere human sowing.
The branch's changing a thing into a new state performs the reversal from standing crop to waste.
The branch's pulverizing of dry matter supplies the material endpoint in which the expected yield becomes unrecoverable.

structural_cues: The focus follows immediately after the counterfactual destruction of the crop.
The paired question in 56:64 distinguishes human handling from actual growth.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies work, growth, state-change, and pulverization; I supply the accounting arrow from invested work plus expected yield to an unrecovered balance. The alternative is a non-economic lament over physical destruction alone.

changed_reading.before: We have incurred an unspecified charge.
changed_reading.after: Our labor and expected harvest have become a binding negative balance with no yield to discharge it.

context_deltas.mechanism: Pulverization is followed by a sustained speech-state and then explicit deprivation, converting the lasting-calamity branch into an aftermath that remains cognitively, socially, and materially present.

activation_trace.role: The branch's adherent calamity supplies the focus model of ruin that continues beyond the destructive event.
The branch's complete fragmentation gives the abiding calamity a concrete initiating event.
The branch's action extended through the day supports reading the speakers' response as a maintained state.
The branch's talk and verbal play supplies the speech activity in which the loss continues to occupy the group.
The branch's failure to obtain the desired thing carries the calamity forward as continuing deprivation.

structural_cues: The construction فَظَلْتُمْ تَفَكَّهُونَ presents an ongoing reaction before the quoted plural declarations.
The nominal plural predicates in 56:66-67 state conditions rather than momentary acts.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies fragmentation, maintained speech, and deprivation; I infer that these stages make the loss adhere after the crop is gone. The live alternative is that the talk is brief astonishment rather than a durable aftermath.

changed_reading.before: We have met a lasting but undefined misfortune.
changed_reading.after: The shattered crop has become an abiding condition that persists in our speech and deprivation.

context_deltas.mechanism: The adversative continuation recategorizes the speakers' first diagnosis: their deepest condition is not merely a charge imposed on them but exclusion from the benefit that would have answered their work.

activation_trace.role: The binding charge supplies the speakers' initial accounting diagnosis.
The creditor-debtor relation leaves open whether the speakers owe or are failed claimants.
The branch's missing of the desired object supplies the corrected category of deprivation.

structural_cues: بَلْ directly joins 56:67 to 56:66 as a correction or escalation.
إِنَّا and نَحْنُ preserve the same plural speakers across the two nominal predicates.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies adjacent declarations joined by بَلْ; I read the second as correcting the category from liability to denied receipt. It may instead intensify the first without fully canceling it, so both models remain live.

changed_reading.before: We are burdened because a loss has been charged to us.
changed_reading.after: More exactly, we are failed beneficiaries: the expected good has been withheld from us.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later sequence presents water as an allotted share delivered from beyond the users and fire as usable provision, then answers with gratitude and lordship; the debt relation becomes beneficiary dependence rather than only punitive extraction.

activation_trace.role: The creditor-debtor bond supplies a relational debt frame capable of being revised by received benefits.
The branch's allotted share of water supplies a benefit received as a portion rather than self-produced property.
The branch's delivery from above distinguishes the delivering agent from the human recipients.
The branch's recognition of benefit and praise of its giver supplies the fitting response to receipt.
The branch's useful provision for needs makes fire part of the same economy of received benefit.
The branch's mastery and lordship identifies the governing side of the asymmetrical benefit relation.

structural_cues: The recurring 'you or We' questions separate human use from origination and delivery.
The sequence moves from deprivation through water and fire to gratitude and glorification.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies shares, delivery, useful provision, gratitude, and lordship; I infer a beneficiary's indebtedness to the giver. The alternative is that these examples correct despair without making غ ر م itself name grateful obligation.

changed_reading.before: We are debtors under an extracting claimant.
changed_reading.after: We are dependent recipients whose debt-like bond arises from benefits we neither originate nor secure.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the focus is naturally heard as loss, while the attachment branch is affective and the ش ي ء activation is form-distant in a context of willing. It remains anchored in focus غ ر م and is sharpened by expected fruit and continued talk; downstream prose should label it an attachment resonance, not a lexical replacement.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The غ ر م branch of infatuated clinging permits the ruined speakers to be heard as still bound to the anticipated crop.

activation_trace.role: The branch's intense attachment supplies the affective inability to release the lost expectation.
The branch's attraction of the soul to a thing activates desire as the bond beneath the speakers' reaction.
The branch's desirable fruit supplies the concrete anticipated object around which attachment formed.
The branch's talk keeps the absent fruit socially and mentally present after its destruction.

changed_reading.before: We are only victims of an external crop loss.
changed_reading.after: We remain gripped by the desired fruit and by the expectation that survived its destruction.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This reverses the usual debtor direction: the reciprocal غريم branch allows a creditor as well as a debtor, while the harvest context supplies work expecting return and the next ayah supplies nonreceipt. It remains focus-anchored but should be rendered as a relational inversion, not as the primary gloss of مُغْرَمُونَ.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The two-sided غريم relation lets the speakers occupy the claimant side of the focus word.

activation_trace.role: The branch explicitly accommodates both sides of a clinging debt relation, permitting claimant-side activation.
The branch's work and earning supplies the basis on which the speakers expect a return.
The branch's wage assigned for work activates the expected payment side of the harvest relation.
The branch's failure to obtain the desired return makes the claimant effectively unpaid.

changed_reading.before: We are debtors who must pay for the failed crop.
changed_reading.after: We are unpaid claimants whose work has yielded no return, so the debt relation clings without satisfaction.

strongest_changes: The sowing-growth-destruction sequence turns generic liability into an unrecovered harvest account.
بَلْ نَحْنُ مَحْرُومُونَ revises imposed burden into denied benefit while preserving both readings.
The larger origination and provision sequence recasts creditor-debtor attachment as dependent agency and received benefit.
summary.what_was_special: One compact predicate carries four live branch domains: monetary liability, creditor-debtor attachment, abiding calamity, and affective fixation. The immediate crop sequence activates all four without forcing them into a single final gloss.
remaining_uncertainties: Whether the creator-user asymmetry genuinely licenses a debt relation or only frames dependence.
Whether بَلْ cancels the liability diagnosis or intensifies it by naming deprivation as its substance.
The attachment and unpaid-claimant readings remain branch-backed but form-distant and should stay explicitly exploratory.
